vsm1.2:73.2: nesajjikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.
vsm1.2:73.3: Tena pana nesajjikena rattiyā tīsu yāmesu ekaṃ yāmaṃ uṭṭhāya caṅkamitabbaṃ. Iriyāpathesu hi nipajjitumeva na vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:74.2: Tattha ukkaṭṭhassa neva apassenaṃ, na dussapallatthikā, na āyogapaṭṭo vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:74.4: Mudukassa apassenampi dussapallatthikāpi āyogapaṭṭopi bibbohanampi pañcaṅgopi sattaṅgopi vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:74.6: Sattaṅgo nāma piṭṭhiapassayena ca ubhatopassesu apassayehi ca saddhiṃ kato.
vsm1.2:74.7: Taṃ kira miḷābhayattherassa akaṃsu. Thero anāgāmī hutvā parinibbāyi.
vsm1.2:74.8: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi seyyaṃ kappitamatte dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati. Ayamettha bhedo.
vsm1.2:75.1: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, ‘‘seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharatī’’ti (dī. ni. 3.320; ma. ni. 1.186) vuttassa cetaso vinibandhassa upacchedanaṃ,
vsm1.2:76.1:
Ābhujitvāna pallaṅkaṃ, paṇidhāya ujuṃ tanuṃ;
Nisīdanto vikampeti, mārassa hadayaṃ yati.
vsm1.2:76.2:
Seyyasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ, hitvā āraddhavīriyo;
Nisajjābhirato bhikkhu, sobhayanto tapovanaṃ.
vsm1.2:76.3:
Nirāmisaṃ pītisukhaṃ, yasmā samadhigacchati;
Tasmā samanuyuñjeyya, dhīro nesajjikaṃ vatanti.
vsm1.2:77.1:
Idāni –
Kusalattikato ceva, dhutādīnaṃ vibhāgato;
Samāsabyāsato cāpi, viññātabbo vinicchayoti. –
Imissā gāthāya vasena vaṇṇanā hoti.
vsm1.2:78.1: Tattha kusalattikatoti sabbāneva hi dhutaṅgāni sekkhaputhujjanakhīṇāsavānaṃ vasena siyā kusalāni,
vsm1.2:78.3: Yo pana vadeyya ‘‘pāpiccho icchāpakato āraññiko hotīti ādivacanato (a. ni. 5.181; pari. 325) akusalampi dhutaṅga’’nti.
vsm1.2:78.4: So vattabbo – na mayaṃ ‘‘akusalacittena araññe na vasatī’’ti vadāma.
vsm1.2:78.5: Yassa hi araññe nivāso, so āraññiko. So ca pāpiccho vā bhaveyya appiccho vā.
vsm1.2:78.6: Imāni pana tena tena samādānena dhutakilesattā dhutassa bhikkhuno aṅgāni, kilesadhunanato vā dhutanti laddhavohāraṃ ñāṇaṃ aṅgametesanti dhutaṅgāni.
vsm1.2:78.7: Atha vā dhutāni ca tāni paṭipakkhaniddhunanato aṅgāni ca paṭipattiyātipi dhutaṅgānīti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.2:78.8: Na ca akusalena koci dhuto nāma hoti, yassetāni aṅgāni bhaveyyuṃ, na ca akusalaṃ kiñci dhunāti, yesaṃ taṃ aṅgantikatvā dhutaṅgānīti vucceyyuṃ.
vsm1.2:78.9: Nāpi akusalaṃ cīvaraloluppādīni ceva niddhunāti paṭipattiyā ca aṅgaṃ hoti.
vsm1.2:79.1: ‘‘Yesampi kusalattikavinimuttaṃ dhutaṅgaṃ, tesaṃ atthato dhutaṅgameva natthi.
vsm1.2:79.2: Asantaṃ kassa dhunanato dhutaṅgaṃ nāma bhavissati.
vsm1.2:79.3: Dhutaguṇe samādāya vattatīti vacanavirodhopi ca nesaṃ āpajjati,
vsm1.2:79.4: tasmā taṃ na gahetabba’’nti ayaṃ tāva kusalattikato vaṇṇanā.
vsm1.2:80.1: Dhutādīnaṃvibhāgatoti dhuto veditabbo. Dhutavādo veditabbo. Dhutadhammā veditabbā. Dhutaṅgāni veditabbāni. Kassa dhutaṅgasevanā sappāyāti veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:81.1: Tattha dhutoti dhutakileso vā puggalo kilesadhunano vā dhammo.
vsm1.2:81.2: Dhutavādoti ettha pana atthi dhuto na dhutavādo, atthi na dhuto dhutavādo,
vsm1.2:81.3: atthi neva dhuto na dhutavādo, atthi dhuto ceva dhutavādo ca.
vsm1.2:82.1: Tattha yo dhutaṅgena attano kilese dhuni, paraṃ pana dhutaṅgena na ovadati, nānusāsati bākulatthero viya, ayaṃ dhuto na dhutavādo.
vsm1.2:82.2: Yathāha, ‘‘tayidaṃ āyasmā bākulo dhuto na dhutavādo’’ti.
vsm1.2:82.3: Yo pana na dhutaṅgena attano kilese dhuni, kevalaṃ aññe dhutaṅgena ovadati anusāsati upanandatthero viya, ayaṃ na dhuto dhutavādo.
vsm1.2:82.4: Yathāha, ‘‘tayidaṃ āyasmā upanando sakyaputto na dhuto dhutavādo’’ti.
vsm1.2:82.5: Yo ubhayavipanno lāḷudāyī viya, ayaṃ neva dhuto na dhutavādo.
vsm1.2:82.6: Yathāha, ‘‘tayidaṃ āyasmā lāḷudāyī neva dhuto na dhutavādo’’ti.
vsm1.2:82.7: Yo pana ubhayasampanno dhammasenāpati viya, ayaṃ dhuto ceva dhutavādo ca.
vsm1.2:82.8: Yathāha, ‘‘tayidaṃ āyasmā sāriputto dhuto ceva dhutavādo cāti.
vsm1.2:83.1: Dhutadhammā veditabbāti appicchatā, santuṭṭhitā, sallekhatā, pavivekatā, idamatthitāti
vsm1.2:83.2: ime dhutaṅgacetanāya parivārakā pañca dhammā ‘‘appicchataṃyeva nissāyā’’tiādivacanato (a. ni. 5.181; pari. 325) dhutadhammā nāma.
vsm1.2:84.1: Tattha appicchatā ca santuṭṭhitā ca alobho.
vsm1.2:84.2: Sallekhatā ca pavivekatā ca dvīsu dhammesu anupatanti alobhe ca amohe ca. Idamatthitā ñāṇameva.
vsm1.2:84.5: Alobhena ca anuññātānaṃ paṭisevanamukhena pavattaṃ kāmasukhānuyogaṃ,
vsm1.2:84.6: amohena dhutaṅgesu atisallekhamukhena pavattaṃ attakilamathānuyogaṃ dhunāti. Tasmā ime dhammā dhutadhammāti veditabbā.
vsm1.2:85.1: Dhutaṅgāni veditabbānīti terasa dhutaṅgāni veditabbāni paṃsukūlikaṅgaṃ…pe… nesajjikaṅganti.
vsm1.2:86.1: Kassa dhutaṅgasevanā sappāyāti rāgacaritassa ceva mohacaritassa ca.
vsm1.2:86.2: Kasmā? Dhutaṅgasevanā hi dukkhāpaṭipadā ceva sallekhavihāro ca.
vsm1.2:86.3: Dukkhāpaṭipadañca nissāya rāgo vūpasammati. Sallekhaṃ nissāya appamattassa moho pahīyati.
vsm1.2:86.5: Tattha hissa asaṅghaṭṭiyamānassa viharato dosopi vūpasammatīti ayaṃ dhutādīnaṃ vibhāgato vaṇṇanā.
vsm1.2:87.1: Samāsabyāsatoti imāni pana dhutaṅgāni samāsato tīṇi sīsaṅgāni,
vsm1.2:87.7: Abbhokāsikaṅgaṃ rakkhantassa kiṃ atthi rukkhamūlikaṅgayathāsanthatikaṅgesu rakkhitabbaṃ nāma.
vsm1.2:87.9: āraññikaṅgaṃ, paṃsukūlikaṅgaṃ, tecīvarikaṅgaṃ, nesajjikaṅgaṃ, sosānikaṅganti imāni pañca asambhinnaṅgāni cāti aṭṭheva honti.
vsm1.2:88.1: Puna dve cīvarapaṭisaṃyuttāni, pañca piṇḍapātapaṭisaṃyuttāni, pañca senāsanapaṭisaṃyuttāni, ekaṃ vīriyapaṭisaṃyuttanti evaṃ cattārova honti.
vsm1.2:88.3: Puna sabbāneva nissayavasena dve honti paccayanissitāni dvādasa, vīriyanissitaṃ ekanti.
vsm1.2:88.5: Yassa hi dhutaṅgaṃ sevantassa kammaṭṭhānaṃ vaḍḍhati, tena sevitabbāni. Yassa sevato hāyati, tena na sevitabbāni.
vsm1.2:88.6: Yassa pana sevatopi asevatopi vaḍḍhateva, na hāyati,
vsm1.2:88.7: tenāpi pacchimaṃ janataṃ anukampantena sevitabbāni. Yassāpi sevatopi asevatopi na vaḍḍhati, tenāpi sevitabbāniyeva āyatiṃ vāsanatthāyāti.
vsm1.2:89.1: Evaṃ sevitabbāsevitabbavasena duvidhānipi sabbāneva cetanāvasena ekavidhāni honti.
vsm1.2:89.2: Ekameva hi dhutaṅgaṃ samādānacetanāti. Aṭṭhakathāyampi vuttaṃ ‘‘yā cetanā, taṃ dhutaṅganti vadantī’’ti.
vsm1.2:90.1: Byāsato pana bhikkhūnaṃ terasa, bhikkhunīnaṃ aṭṭha,
vsm1.2:90.2: sāmaṇerānaṃ dvādasa, sikkhamānasāmaṇerīnaṃ satta, upāsakaupāsikānaṃ dveti dvācattālīsa honti.
vsm1.2:91.1: Sace pana abbhokāse āraññikaṅgasampannaṃ susānaṃ hoti,
vsm1.2:91.2: ekopi bhikkhu ekappahārena sabbadhutaṅgāni paribhuñjituṃ sakkoti.
vsm1.2:91.3: Bhikkhunīnaṃ pana āraññikaṅgaṃ khalupacchābhattikaṅgañca dvepi sikkhāpadeneva paṭikkhittāni,
vsm1.2:91.4: abbhokāsikaṅgaṃ, rukkhamūlikaṅgaṃ, sosānikaṅganti imāni tīṇi dupparihārāni.
vsm1.2:91.5: Bhikkhuniyā hi dutiyikaṃ vinā vasituṃ na vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:91.6: Evarūpe ca ṭhāne samānacchandā dutiyikā dullabhā. Sacepi labheyya saṃsaṭṭhavihārato na mucceyya. Evaṃ sati yassatthāya dhutaṅgaṃ seveyya, svevassā attho na sampajjeyya.
vsm1.2:91.7: Evaṃ paribhuñjituṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya pañca hāpetvā bhikkhunīnaṃ aṭṭheva hontīti veditabbāni.
vsm1.2:92.1: Yathāvuttesu pana ṭhapetvā tecīvarikaṅgaṃ sesāni dvādasa sāmaṇerānaṃ,
vsm1.2:92.4: imāni dve patirūpāni ceva sakkā ca paribhuñjitunti dve dhutaṅgānīti evaṃ byāsato dvecattālīsa hontīti ayaṃ samāsabyāsato vaṇṇanā.
vsm1.2:93.1: Ettāvatā ca ‘‘sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño’’ti imissā gāthāya sīlasamādhipaññāmukhena desite visuddhimagge yehi appicchatāsantuṭṭhitādīhi guṇehi vuttappakārassa sīlassa vodānaṃ hoti,
vsm1.2:93.3:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Dhutaṅganiddeso nāma dutiyo paricchedo.
